assumed: Reads small non-negative whole numbers, can enter a number; teacher may read text aloud.

evidenceLimits: Virtual result does not certify handling a ruler/thermometer, physical safety or actual observation.
Optional guide may be used; no independent-performance, mastery, retention or efficacy inference.
No persistence, personal history, awards or verified runtime game links.
